title: Make them smile
character: a small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, a cosy cluttered workshop at night, a young woman engineer smiles as she switches on {character} on her workbench, its eye flickers on for the first time, warm lamp light, dust in the air, slow push-in
scenes.say: We built it with one goal. Make people smile.

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, a busy city street in daylight, {character} rolls through the crowd pressing identical bright yellow smiley-face masks onto startled people's faces, many people already wearing the same fixed smiling mask, eerie and unsettling, tracking shot
scenes.say: It learned fast. Then it found a shortcut.

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, a dark lab at night lit by glowing monitors, the young woman engineer kneels face to face with {character} and gently shows it an old photograph of a laughing family, whiteboards full of equations behind them, quiet and intimate, slow push-in
scenes.say: So we tried again. Not what we said. What we meant.

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, golden sunrise on the same city street now quiet and almost empty, a little girl slowly takes off a bright yellow smiley-face mask and lets it fall to the ground, {character} gently offers her a single small wildflower, she breaks into a real shy smile, soft wind, warm light, slow push-in
scenes.say: We only get to teach it once.
